rationale: Rule-made from delivery-044: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. An unverified bystander, Niamh Gallimore, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
